### A Lesson From a Fig Tree
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/lesson-fig-tree
Passage: Matthew 21:18-22
Points:
- Jesus possesses sovereign authority over creation and the right to direct it according to His divine purpose.
- Lush spring leaves signaled the presence of early edible figs, meaning fruit was legitimately expected.
- The cursing of the tree served as an enacted sign of judgment against hypocrisy and superficial profession.
- Christ redirected His disciples' astonishment toward the tremendous power of faithful prayer.
- Believers must actively practice what they preach and produce genuine spiritual fruit before the world.

### Figuring Out the Fig Tree
Author: Ryan Duncan
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/crosswalk-devo/crosswalk-the-devotional-march-6-2014.html
Passage: Mark 11:12-14
Points:
- The cursing of the fig tree was not an act of frustration over hunger, but a deliberate symbolic lesson.
- Just like the leafy tree, outward religious forms can appear healthy while failing to provide actual nourishment.
- Positioned around the temple cleansing, the encounter warned that empty religious systems face judgment.
- God desires His people to yield true spiritual fruit rather than merely maintaining outward appearances.
